versions.changelog:
Initial release of math-screenshot-to-giscus:  

- Converts Chinese math textbook screenshots or text (with formulas) into giscus/GitHub Discussion compatible Markdown.
- Handles two input types: screenshots use vision_analyze for symbol confirmation and explanation; text input is converted directly without analysis unless requested.
- Ensures all LaTeX commands use double backslashes (e.g., \\\\frac) for reliable rendering in GitHub MathJax.
- Clearly documents handling of unsupported LaTeX matrix environments and provides alternative formatting strategies.
- Highlights critical pitfalls—such as issues with Chinese punctuation adjacent to $...$, and avoiding \begin{bmatrix}—with tested solutions.
- Outputs both Markdown source (for user copy-paste) and rendered previews; for complex cases, supports file-based delivery to avoid copy/paste issues with double backslashes.
